text:
maria: noticed p99 oscillation on hosted API starting ~03:10, p95 fine but p99 jumping 200ms -> 1.2s
ajay: seeing same on dashboards, timeline correlates with KV cache eviction spikes and kernel selection events
maria: profiler traces show repeated kernel switches mid-request; batching patterns look noisy
infra-bot: alert: hosted-api p99 > 1s for 3m (alert id A-8241)
nate: did we push a runtime change? no runtime deploys from last 24h on prod 
ajay: there was a batching tweak by @lina at 01:58 (reduce max_wait 12ms->6ms) to favor latency on small workloads
lina: correct — change intended to reduce p50 for interactive flows, didn't expect impact at tail
maria: flamegraph uploaded: https://perf.internal/fg/2009876543 (see hotspot around kernel_switch and kv_lookup)
ajay: log sample from one host: `kernel_switch: from=optimized_v2 to=fallback_v1 reason=kernel_misfit seq=512 batches=3` repeated every ~30-60s
maria: KV metrics show eviction_rate spike at same times for tenant=acme-prod, partial-kv-hit ratio down -> more backend lookups
lina: hypothesis: smaller batching window increases small-batch frequency -> batcher sees different seq-length distrib -> kernel heuristic oscillates -> frequent kernel swaps cause transient stalls and extra KV lookups -> p99 jumps
nate: can we repro on staging with heavy small-batch traffic + acme-prod traffic pattern?
ajay: ran micro-repro on noisy shard, `pprof` 30s CPU shows ~18% time in switch_kernel() and ~25% in kv_lookup()/kv_miss handlers
maria: mitigation options: 1) revert batching window change (quick), 2) pin kernel selection at request start to avoid mid-request swap, 3) raise prefetch threshold to avoid partial KV misses
lina: rolling rollback to previous batching config to canary subset now (3 nodes)
devops: canary rollback scheduled and applied to nodes {r-12,r-13,r-14} — watching metrics
maria: also throttling tenant acme-prod by 20% token rate as temporary noisy-neighbor mitigation
ajay: canary results: p99 on canary dropped from 1.1s -> 220ms within 2 minutes after rollback
maria: great, keep canary for 10m then expand to 20% if stable
nate: follow-up action items: add per-tenant `kernel_swap_count` metric, `kv_partial_hit_ratio`, and an alert when swap_count > X/min correlated with p99>500ms
lina: created ticket INF-452: "batching heuristic coupling -> kernel selection oscillation" assigned to @ajay and @maria, link: https://goto/redwood/INF-452
maria: thanks team, solid triage. we'll keep monitoring and schedule a deeper postmortem if it reappears :thumbsup:
infra-bot: incident update: mitigation applied (batching rollback + tenant throttle), monitoring window started
